investigation_scope: Independent KKT Correctness and False Acceptance Prevention Audit

defect_a_tolerance.code_line: if n_changes == 0 and res_inf_A <= 1.0e-5 and raw_heal_count == 0 and raw_overshoot_count == 0:
defect_a_tolerance.issue: Declared tolerance 1.0e-5 kN/mm is relaxed by one order of magnitude above the governing Mode-I scientific threshold TAU_RES = 1.0e-6 kN/mm.

defect_b_missing_kkt_predicate.issue: kkt_lower_valid and kkt_upper_valid are computed as telemetry metrics but are omitted from the termination decision predicate.

defect_c_heuristic_suppression.issue: Permanent release suppression of chattering boundary nodes with positive dual residual R_d > 1.0e-6 kN/mm leaves active KKT violations at the lower bound, achieving active-set stationarity (|Delta A| = 0) at the expense of true variational inequality optimality.
